desc: Read the integers N and K, followed by the sequence A of N non-negative integers.
Implement a recursive backtracking function (or use `itertools.combinations`) to generate every unique subset of K elements from A.
For each generated subset, compute the cumulative XOR of its elements.
Maintain a global maximum variable initialized to -1 and update it whenever a larger XOR sum is found.
Print the final maximum XOR value to standard output.
Implement the solution using `sys.stdin` for fast I/O, use `itertools.combinations` to generate subsets of size $K$, compute the XOR sum for each, track the maximum, and print the result.
Wrap the code in the specified delimiters.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
